newsitem.title: UK: Britain says it will send 200 troops to Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Britain says it will send 200 troops to Zaire.

text.p: Britain said on Monday that it will send 200 troops to Zaire as "an additional precaution" in case British and Commonwealth citizens need to be evacuated from the African nation.

"There is no need as yet to evacuate British nationals. We are taking additional precautions putting troops closer to hand in case they should be needed," a spokesman for the Ministry of Defence told Reuters.

He said the troops will be leaving in the next few days and will fly to Libreville in Gabon. Thirty-eight British Royal Marines are already in Brazzaville in the Congo ready to evacuate people from the Zairean capital Kinshasa.

Britain announced the additional troops as rebels were advancing towards the capital and U.S. envoy Bill Richardson arrived in Kinshasa to try to negotiate a settlement in the nation's seven-month civil war.
